description: Defines a base class for testing decoding of HTTP/2 and HPACK encodings, including helper functions and mechanisms for segmenting input buffers during tests.

classes.name: RandomDecoderTest
classes.description: A base class for testing the decoding of byte sequences with various buffer segmentations, primarily for HTTP/2 and HPACK encoding tests.

methods.name: ToStringPiece
methods.description: Converts an array of data into an absl::string_view.

methods.name: CorruptEnum
methods.description: Overwrites an enum value with a random value, possibly invalid, for testing purposes.

methods.name: StartDecoding
methods.description: Pure virtual method to start decoding, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: ResumeDecoding
methods.description: Pure virtual method to resume decoding, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: StopDecodeOnDone
methods.description: Determines if decoding should stop when kDecodeDone is returned.

methods.name: DecodeSegments
methods.description: Decodes input buffer in segments based on a segment size selector.

methods.name: DecodeSegmentsAndValidate
methods.description: Decodes buffer in segments and validates the final status.

methods.name: SelectRemaining
methods.description: Returns a segment size selector that consumes all remaining input.

methods.name: SelectOne
methods.description: Returns a segment size selector that consumes one byte at a time.

methods.name: SelectZeroAndOne
methods.description: Returns a segment size selector that alternates between zero and one byte segments.

methods.name: SelectRandom
methods.description: Returns a segment size selector that segments input randomly.

methods.name: DecodeAndValidateSeveralWays
methods.description: Decodes input multiple times with different segmentations, validating each time.

methods.name: ToValidator
methods.description: Converts various validator types into a standard Validator function.

methods.name: ValidateDoneAndEmpty
methods.description: Validator wrapper that checks for completion and empty buffer.

methods.name: ValidateDoneAndOffset
methods.description: Validator wrapper that checks for completion and specific buffer offset.
